```{=css}
/* Ensure circular avatar images */
.quarto-grid-item .card-img-top {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: 20%;
  margin: 1.5rem auto 0 auto;
}

.quarto-grid-item {
  transition: transform 0.2s ease-in-out;
}

.quarto-grid-item:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
}
```
